messages:
deploy-bot: starting deploy of inference-api@v2.3.1-hotfix to production. rollout policy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. change window: emergency.
laura-sre: seeing a spike of 500/503s in canary, holding the rollout. :eyes:
sam-platform: can you paste the canary logs? curious if it's auth-cache again or upstream KV.
laura-sre: logs show redis timeouts during compaction, lots of `ERR timeout after 10s` around 14:02 UTC. stack trace points to kv-client flush.
mia-product: confirmed customer reports for /embeddings endpoint failing intermittently. impact: some PLG users, not full outage.
raj-eng: I can build a hotfix to add retry/backoff and reduce compaction batch size. will push a patched image. ETA ~20m.
olivia-cto: if the fix takes >30m to validate, we need expedited approval to bypass scheduled change window.
sam-platform: +1 for expedited from infra, assigning to @olivia-cto for approval.
olivia-cto: approved for emergency deploy. conditions: pin canary, watch error rate; auto-rollback if error rate > 3% for 5m.
raj-eng: preparing v2.3.1-hotfix.1, bump image tag and add kv retry logic. pushing now.
deploy-bot: new deploy queued: inference-api@v2.3.1-hotfix.1 (user: raj-eng). initiating canary 5%.
deploy-bot: canary 5% report -> latency +4ms, error rate 0.8%.
laura-sre: errors down vs previous canary. keeping at 5% for an additional 5m to validate memory/GC.
deploy-bot: canary -> 25%. metrics stable, error rate 0.6%, tail latency improved.
sam-platform: pinned traffic routing for fallback: stable -> inference-api@v2.3.0 until midnight UTC as precaution.
mia-product: drafting release note blurb: 'Hotfix: mitigate Redis timeouts during compaction by adding retries and reducing batch size. Addresses intermittent failures for embeddings.'
raj-eng: changelog snippet: ```- fix(kv): add exponential backoff & retry to KV client
- perf: reduce compaction batch size to lower latency spikes
- test: add regression for compaction under load```
laura-sre: rolling to 100% now. monitoring dashboards and SLOs in prod.
deploy-bot: rollout complete -> 100%. final metrics: error rate 0.3%, p95 latency -6ms.
laura-sre: confirm final checks ok. no rollback needed. closing postmortem thread in incidents if anything emerges. :white_check_mark:
